evidence: The atomic and phase composition were measured with X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS, CG scientiﬁc ESCALAB 220iXL) after the removal of the 2–3 nm surface layer through sputtering and the crystallinity of the ﬁlm was analyzed by grazing incident X-ray diffraction (GIXRD, D/MAX-2500). The sheet resistance and ﬁlm thickness were measured with a four-point probe (Keithley 2400) and ﬁeld emission scanning electron microscope (FESEM, JEOL JSM-840A), respectively. The capacitance-voltage (C-V) characteristics of the TiC xNy ﬁlm was measured with probe station set (Agilent 4284A). The work function of the ﬁlm was also examined by UPS (ultraviolet photoelectron spectroscopy) and the system is the same as XPS.
